# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# SVA Studio – Production-Betriebsprofil (ohne Monitoring)
#
# Profil fuer den Stack "studio" auf Endpoint "sva".
# Nur App + Redis + Postgres. Monitoring wird separat betrieben.
#
# Die meisten historischen Werte werden weiterhin als Portainer-Stack-Variablen
# gesetzt. Das clusterweit privilegierte Waste-Provisionierer-Passwort ist davon
# ausgenommen und wird ausschließlich als externes, versioniertes Swarm-Secret
# in den vorhandenen Provisioner-Pfad gemountet.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
services:
  app:
    image: ghcr.io/smart-village-solutions/sva-studio
    environment:
      - "NODE_ENV=production"
      - "HOST=0.0.0.0"
      - "PORT=3000"
      - "SVA_DEPLOY_REVISION=${SVA_DEPLOY_REVISION:-unset}"
      - "SVA_RUNTIME_PROFILE=${SVA_RUNTIME_PROFILE}"
      - "SVA_STUDIO_SSF_LOGIN_ORIGIN=${SVA_STUDIO_SSF_LOGIN_ORIGIN:-}"
      - "SVA_STUDIO_SSF_DATABASE_URL=${SVA_STUDIO_SSF_DATABASE_URL:-}"
      - "SVA_STUDIO_SSF_ROOT_DATABASE_URL=${SVA_STUDIO_SSF_ROOT_DATABASE_URL:-}"
      - "SVA_AUTH_CLIENT_SECRET=${SVA_AUTH_CLIENT_SECRET}"
      - "SVA_AUTH_STATE_SECRET=${SVA_AUTH_STATE_SECRET}"
      - "SVA_INSTANCE_PROVISIONER_INTERNAL_BASE_URL=http://provisioner:3000"
      - "KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_CLIENT_SECRET=${KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_CLIENT_SECRET}"
      - "ENCRYPTION_KEY=${ENCRYPTION_KEY}"
      - "IAM_PII_KEYRING_JSON=${IAM_PII_KEYRING_JSON}"
      - "APP_DB_PASSWORD=${APP_DB_PASSWORD}"
      - "STUDIO_JOB_WORKER_DB_USER=${STUDIO_JOB_WORKER_DB_USER:-sva_job_worker}"
      - "STUDIO_JOB_WORKER_DB_PASSWORD=${STUDIO_JOB_WORKER_DB_PASSWORD}"
      - "REDIS_PASSWORD=${REDIS_PASSWORD}"
      - "REDIS_SNAPSHOT_HMAC_SECRET=${REDIS_SNAPSHOT_HMAC_SECRET}"
      - "SVA_PLUGIN_OPERATION_WORKER_ENABLED=true"
      - "SVA_PLUGIN_OPERATION_WORKER_LANE=default"
      - "ENABLE_OTEL=false"
      - "SVA_ENABLE_SERVER_CONSOLE_LOGS=${SVA_ENABLE_SERVER_CONSOLE_LOGS:-false}"
      - "SVA_AUTH_DEBUG_HEADERS=${SVA_AUTH_DEBUG_HEADERS:-false}"
      - "SVA_MAINSERVER_SCOPE_RESOLVER_MODE=${SVA_MAINSERVER_SCOPE_RESOLVER_MODE:-shadow}"
      - "POSTGRES_DB=sva_studio"
      - "APP_DB_USER=${APP_DB_USER}"
      - "SVA_STUDIO_BRANDING=${SVA_STUDIO_BRANDING:-sva-studio}"
      - "SVA_PUBLIC_BASE_URL=${SVA_PUBLIC_BASE_URL}"
      - "SVA_DOCUMENTATION_BASE_URL=${SVA_DOCUMENTATION_BASE_URL:-}"
      - "SVA_AUTH_ISSUER=${SVA_AUTH_ISSUER}"
      - "SVA_STUDIO_MCP_ENABLED=${SVA_STUDIO_MCP_ENABLED:-true}"
      - "SVA_STUDIO_MCP_ISSUER=${SVA_STUDIO_MCP_ISSUER:-}"
      - "SVA_STUDIO_MCP_AUDIENCE=${SVA_STUDIO_MCP_AUDIENCE:-sva-studio-mcp}"
      - "SVA_STUDIO_MCP_CLIENT_ID=${SVA_STUDIO_MCP_CLIENT_ID:-sva-studio-mcp}"
      - "SVA_AUTH_CLIENT_ID=${SVA_AUTH_CLIENT_ID}"
      - "SVA_AUTH_REDIRECT_URI=${SVA_AUTH_REDIRECT_URI}"
      - "SVA_AUTH_POST_LOGOUT_REDIRECT_URI=${SVA_AUTH_POST_LOGOUT_REDIRECT_URI}"
      - "IAM_PII_ACTIVE_KEY_ID=k1"
      - "IAM_CSRF_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=${IAM_CSRF_ALLOWED_ORIGINS}"
      - "SVA_PARENT_DOMAIN=${SVA_PARENT_DOMAIN}"
      - "SVA_STUDIO_ROOT_HOST=${SVA_STUDIO_ROOT_HOST:-}"
      - "SVA_ALLOWED_INSTANCE_IDS=${SVA_ALLOWED_INSTANCE_IDS}"
      - "VITE_IAM_UI_ENABLED=${VITE_IAM_UI_ENABLED}"
      - "VITE_IAM_ADMIN_ENABLED=${VITE_IAM_ADMIN_ENABLED}"
      - "VITE_IAM_BULK_ENABLED=${VITE_IAM_BULK_ENABLED}"
      - "IAM_UI_ENABLED=${IAM_UI_ENABLED}"
      - "IAM_ADMIN_ENABLED=${IAM_ADMIN_ENABLED}"
      - "IAM_BULK_ENABLED=${IAM_BULK_ENABLED}"
      - "IAM_DEBUG_PROFILE_ERRORS=${IAM_DEBUG_PROFILE_ERRORS}"
      - "KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_BASE_URL=${KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_BASE_URL}"
      - "KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_REALM=${KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_REALM}"
      - "KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_CLIENT_ID=${KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_CLIENT_ID}"
      - "IAM_ROLE_RECONCILE_INTERVAL_MS=300000"
      - "IAM_ROLE_RECONCILE_INSTANCE_IDS="
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - node -e "fetch('http://127.0.0.1:3000/health/live').then((r)=>process.exit(r.ok?0:1)).catch(()=>process.exit(1))"
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 20s

  provisioner:
    image: ghcr.io/smart-village-solutions/sva-studio
    entrypoint:
      - ./provisioner-entrypoint.sh
    command:
      - node
      - --import
      - ./otel-bootstrap.mjs
      - .output/server/index.mjs
    environment:
      - "NODE_ENV=production"
      - "HOST=0.0.0.0"
      - "PORT=3000"
      - "SVA_DEPLOY_REVISION=${SVA_DEPLOY_REVISION:-unset}"
      - "SVA_RUNTIME_PROFILE=${SVA_RUNTIME_PROFILE}"
      - "SVA_STUDIO_SSF_LOGIN_ORIGIN=${SVA_STUDIO_SSF_LOGIN_ORIGIN:-}"
      - "SVA_STUDIO_SSF_DATABASE_URL=${SVA_STUDIO_SSF_DATABASE_URL:-}"
      - "SVA_STUDIO_SSF_ROOT_DATABASE_URL=${SVA_STUDIO_SSF_ROOT_DATABASE_URL:-}"
      - "SVA_AUTH_CLIENT_SECRET=${SVA_AUTH_CLIENT_SECRET}"
      - "SVA_AUTH_STATE_SECRET=${SVA_AUTH_STATE_SECRET}"
      - "SVA_AUTH_ISSUER=${SVA_AUTH_ISSUER}"
      - "SVA_AUTH_CLIENT_ID=${SVA_AUTH_CLIENT_ID}"
      - "SVA_AUTH_REDIRECT_URI=${SVA_AUTH_REDIRECT_URI}"
      - "SVA_AUTH_POST_LOGOUT_REDIRECT_URI=${SVA_AUTH_POST_LOGOUT_REDIRECT_URI}"
      - "SVA_STUDIO_MCP_ENABLED=${SVA_STUDIO_MCP_ENABLED:-true}"
      - "SVA_STUDIO_MCP_ISSUER=${SVA_STUDIO_MCP_ISSUER:-}"
      - "SVA_STUDIO_MCP_AUDIENCE=${SVA_STUDIO_MCP_AUDIENCE:-sva-studio-mcp}"
      - "SVA_STUDIO_MCP_CLIENT_ID=${SVA_STUDIO_MCP_CLIENT_ID:-sva-studio-mcp}"
      - "SVA_INSTANCE_PROVISIONER_LOCAL_HANDLING=true"
      - "SVA_TRUST_FORWARDED_HEADERS=true"
      - "IAM_CSRF_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=${IAM_CSRF_ALLOWED_ORIGINS}"
      - "SVA_PARENT_DOMAIN=${SVA_PARENT_DOMAIN}"
      - "SVA_STUDIO_ROOT_HOST=${SVA_STUDIO_ROOT_HOST:-}"
      - "SVA_ALLOWED_INSTANCE_IDS=${SVA_ALLOWED_INSTANCE_IDS}"
      - "IAM_UI_ENABLED=${IAM_UI_ENABLED}"
      - "IAM_ADMIN_ENABLED=${IAM_ADMIN_ENABLED}"
      - "IAM_BULK_ENABLED=${IAM_BULK_ENABLED}"
      - "KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_BASE_URL=${KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_BASE_URL}"
      - "KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_REALM=${KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_REALM}"
      - "KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_CLIENT_ID=${KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_CLIENT_ID}"
      - "ENCRYPTION_KEY=${ENCRYPTION_KEY}"
      - "IAM_PII_KEYRING_JSON=${IAM_PII_KEYRING_JSON}"
      - "APP_DB_PASSWORD=${APP_DB_PASSWORD}"
      - "STUDIO_JOB_WORKER_DB_USER=${STUDIO_JOB_WORKER_DB_USER:-sva_job_worker}"
      - "STUDIO_JOB_WORKER_DB_PASSWORD=${STUDIO_JOB_WORKER_DB_PASSWORD}"
      - "POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}"
      - "REDIS_PASSWORD=${REDIS_PASSWORD}"
      - "KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_CLIENT_SECRET=${KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_CLIENT_SECRET}"
      - "ENABLE_OTEL=false"
      - "SVA_ENABLE_SERVER_CONSOLE_LOGS=${SVA_ENABLE_SERVER_CONSOLE_LOGS:-false}"
      - "POSTGRES_DB=sva_studio"
      - "APP_DB_USER=${APP_DB_USER}"
      - "IAM_PII_ACTIVE_KEY_ID=k1"
      - "KEYCLOAK_PROVISIONER_BASE_URL=${KEYCLOAK_PROVISIONER_BASE_URL}"
      - "KEYCLOAK_PROVISIONER_REALM=${KEYCLOAK_PROVISIONER_REALM}"
      - "KEYCLOAK_PROVISIONER_CLIENT_ID=${KEYCLOAK_PROVISIONER_CLIENT_ID}"
      - "KEYCLOAK_PROVISIONER_CLIENT_SECRET=${KEYCLOAK_PROVISIONER_CLIENT_SECRET}"
      - "SVA_KEYCLOAK_PROVISIONER_POLL_INTERVAL_MS=${SVA_KEYCLOAK_PROVISIONER_POLL_INTERVAL_MS:-5000}"
      - "SVA_PROVISIONER_COMBINED_WORKER=true"
      - "SVA_PLUGIN_OPERATION_WORKER_ENABLED=true"
      - "SVA_PLUGIN_OPERATION_WORKER_LANE=privileged"
      - "SVA_PLUGIN_OPERATION_WORKER_CONCURRENCY=1"
      - "WASTE_DATABASE_PROVISIONER_USER=${WASTE_DATABASE_PROVISIONER_USER:-sva_waste_provisioner}"
      - "WASTE_DATABASE_PROVISIONER_PASSWORD_FILE=/run/secrets/waste_database_provisioner_password"
      - "WASTE_DATABASE_PROVISIONER_HOST=postgres"
      - "WASTE_DATABASE_PROVISIONER_PORT=5432"
      - "WASTE_DATABASE_PROVISIONER_DATABASE=sva_studio"
    secrets:
      - waste_database_provisioner_password

  migrate:
    image: ghcr.io/smart-village-solutions/sva-studio
    entrypoint:
      - ./migrate-entrypoint.sh
    environment:
      - "NODE_ENV=production"
      - "SVA_RUNTIME_PROFILE=${SVA_RUNTIME_PROFILE}"
      - "SVA_DEPLOY_REVISION=${SVA_DEPLOY_REVISION:-unset}"
      - "POSTGRES_DB=sva_studio"
      - "POSTGRES_USER=sva"
      - "POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}"
      - "POSTGRES_HOST=postgres"
      - "POSTGRES_PORT=5432"
      - "SVA_MIGRATION_JOB_STACK=${SVA_MIGRATION_JOB_STACK:-}"
      - "SVA_MIGRATION_TARGET_STACK=${SVA_MIGRATION_TARGET_STACK:-}"
      - "GOOSE_WRAPPER=packages/data/scripts/goosew.sh"
      - "MIGRATIONS_DIR=packages/data/migrations"
      - "GOOSE_CONFIG_PATH=packages/data/goose.config.json"
      - "WASTE_TENANT_MIGRATIONS_ENABLED=true"
      - "WASTE_DATABASE_PROVISIONER_USER=${WASTE_DATABASE_PROVISIONER_USER:-sva_waste_provisioner}"
      - "WASTE_DATABASE_PROVISIONER_PASSWORD_FILE=/run/secrets/waste_database_provisioner_password"
      - "WASTE_DATABASE_PROVISIONER_HOST=postgres"
      - "WASTE_DATABASE_PROVISIONER_PORT=5432"
    secrets:
      - waste_database_provisioner_password

  bootstrap:
    image: ghcr.io/smart-village-solutions/sva-studio
    entrypoint:
      - ./bootstrap-entrypoint.sh
    environment:
      - "NODE_ENV=production"
      - "SVA_RUNTIME_PROFILE=${SVA_RUNTIME_PROFILE}"
      - "SVA_DEPLOY_REVISION=${SVA_DEPLOY_REVISION:-unset}"
      - "POSTGRES_DB=sva_studio"
      - "POSTGRES_USER=sva"
      - "POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}"
      - "POSTGRES_HOST=postgres"
      - "POSTGRES_PORT=5432"
      - "APP_DB_USER=${APP_DB_USER}"
      - "APP_DB_PASSWORD=${APP_DB_PASSWORD}"
      - "STUDIO_JOB_WORKER_DB_USER=${STUDIO_JOB_WORKER_DB_USER:-sva_job_worker}"
      - "STUDIO_JOB_WORKER_DB_PASSWORD=${STUDIO_JOB_WORKER_DB_PASSWORD}"
      - "SVA_ALLOWED_INSTANCE_IDS=${SVA_ALLOWED_INSTANCE_IDS}"
      - "SVA_PARENT_DOMAIN=${SVA_PARENT_DOMAIN}"
      - "SVA_STUDIO_ROOT_HOST=${SVA_STUDIO_ROOT_HOST:-}"
      - "SVA_BOOTSTRAP_JOB_STACK=${SVA_BOOTSTRAP_JOB_STACK:-}"
      - "SVA_BOOTSTRAP_TARGET_STACK=${SVA_BOOTSTRAP_TARGET_STACK:-}"
      - "SVA_BOOTSTRAP_RECONCILE_APP_ROLE=${SVA_BOOTSTRAP_RECONCILE_APP_ROLE:-true}"
      - "SVA_BOOTSTRAP_ENABLE_SCHEMA_GUARD=${SVA_BOOTSTRAP_ENABLE_SCHEMA_GUARD:-true}"
      - "SVA_BOOTSTRAP_ENABLE_INSTANCE_RECONCILE=${SVA_BOOTSTRAP_ENABLE_INSTANCE_RECONCILE:-true}"
      - "SVA_BOOTSTRAP_ENABLE_HOSTNAME_GUARD=${SVA_BOOTSTRAP_ENABLE_HOSTNAME_GUARD:-true}"

  candidate:
    image: ${IMAGE_REF:-ghcr.io/smart-village-solutions/sva-studio:${TAG:-latest}}
    entrypoint:
      - node
      - ./candidate-preflight.mjs
    read_only: true
    cap_drop:
      - ALL
    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true
    deploy:
      replicas: 0
      restart_policy:
        condition: none
    environment:
      - "NODE_ENV=production"
      - "SVA_RUNTIME_PROFILE=${SVA_RUNTIME_PROFILE}"
      - "SVA_ALLOWED_INSTANCE_IDS=${SVA_ALLOWED_INSTANCE_IDS}"
      - "APP_DB_USER=${APP_DB_USER}"
      - "APP_DB_PASSWORD=${APP_DB_PASSWORD}"
      - "POSTGRES_DB=sva_studio"
      - "POSTGRES_HOST=postgres"
      - "POSTGRES_PORT=5432"
      - "IAM_PII_ACTIVE_KEY_ID=${IAM_PII_ACTIVE_KEY_ID}"
      - "IAM_PII_KEYRING_JSON=${IAM_PII_KEYRING_JSON}"
      - "WASTE_DATABASE_PROVISIONER_PASSWORD_FILE=/run/secrets/waste_database_provisioner_password"
    secrets:
      - waste_database_provisioner_password

  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    environment:
      - "REDIS_PASSWORD=${REDIS_PASSWORD}"
    command:
      - sh
      - -ec
      - |
        exec redis-server \
          --appendonly yes \
          --maxmemory 256mb \
          --maxmemory-policy allkeys-lru \
          --requirepass "$${REDIS_PASSWORD}"
    volumes:
      - redis-data:/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ['CMD-SHELL', 'REDISCLI_AUTH=$${REDIS_PASSWORD} redis-cli ping']
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 10

  postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    environment:
      - "POSTGRES_DB=sva_studio"
      - "POSTGRES_USER=sva"
      - "POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}"
    volumes:
      - postgres-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ['CMD-SHELL', 'pg_isready -U $$POSTGRES_USER -d $$POSTGRES_DB']
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 10

volumes:
  postgres-data:
  redis-data:

secrets:
  waste_database_provisioner_password:
    external: true
    name: ${WASTE_DATABASE_PROVISIONER_PASSWORD_SECRET_NAME:-studio_waste_database_provisioner_password_v1}
